landing.faq.title: FAQ
landing.faq.q1.a: Yes — text protection, welcome images, activity stats and the custom bot identity are free forever. The AI features (voice assistant, AI chat, voice moderation) and the voice & chat logs are part of Pro.
landing.faq.q2.q: Which permissions does the bot need?
landing.faq.q2.a: Core permissions to read and manage messages, Manage Roles for the auto role, and Moderate Members for text-protection timeouts. It never asks for Administrator.
landing.faq.q3.a: Six languages: Arabic, English, German, Turkish, French and Russian — pick the bot language in the dashboard.
landing.faq.q4.a: We only store the minimum needed for the features to work: server settings and activity stats. Full details are in the Privacy Policy.
landing.faq.q5.a: Soon — we're building it now. Add the bot today and Pro's AI features will reach you the moment they ship.
landing.faq.q6.a: With Pro, the AI listens for your wake word and answers by voice, powers the /ask and /chat commands, and moderates voice chat by catching offensive language in real time.
landing.faq.q7.q: What is the 20-day check-in on the Free plan?
landing.faq.q7.a: On the Free plan an admin just confirms the bot every 20 days from the dashboard to keep it active. Pro removes the check-in — it runs 24/7.

landing.ctaBand.body: Set it up in your server in a minute — for free

guilds.title: Your servers
guilds.empty: No servers where you are an admin and the bot is a member
guilds.links.hint: Advanced features (automation, chat & voice logs) run on linked servers only. Free: 1 server — Premium: 3 servers.
guilds.linkLimit: You reached your plan’s link limit — unlink another server or upgrade to Premium (3 servers).
voicelog.hint: Presence metadata only (join/leave times) — no audio is recorded and the bot does not need to be in the channel.
voicelog.nobodyActive: Nobody is in a voice channel right now.
stats.growthHint: Cumulative by current members' join dates (leavers not included) — spans the server's whole growth history
settings.voice.enabled.hint: Turns the voice assistant on or off entirely for this server.
settings.voice.wakeWord.hint: The word the bot listens for in voice before your request — e.g. "يا كابتن السرعة".
settings.voice.ttsVoice.hint: The voice the bot speaks with (♂ male, ♀ female).
settings.voice.allowedChannels.hint: Voice channels the bot may join via /join — leave all unchecked to allow every channel.
settings.voice.noVoiceChannels: No voice channels in this server.
settings.personality.hint: Playful, joking replies instead of neutral ones.
settings.language.hint: The language the bot uses in this server — for its text messages (protection notices, default welcome, command replies, weekly summary) and for audio too: the voice assistant's spoken replies and voice commands. Does not affect the dashboard language.
settings.adminRole.hint: Members with this role are treated as bot admins: settings commands, voice kick, and exemption from text protection. Leave empty to restrict all of that to Manage Guild.
protection.title: Protection
protection.enabled.hint: Master switch for all protection features — without it neither voice nor text moderation runs.
protection.dormant.title: Text features are dormant on the bot — text protection and anti-spam will not run
protection.dormant.body: The bot is currently running without permission to read message content. Enable the Message Content Intent on the Bot page of the Discord developer portal and restart the bot — this notice disappears automatically.
protection.voiceModeration.hint: Detects inappropriate language in voice and posts a spoken + text notice when it acts.
protection.voiceKickImmediate.hint: On: the first offensive word = instant kick. Off (recommended): a warning first, kick only on a repeat — fewer wrongful kicks from speech-recognition errors.
protection.textProtection.hint: Automatically deletes messages containing suspicious/scam links or blocked words — edited messages included. Admins are exempt.
protection.textTimeout.hint: For repeated violations within an hour: second offense = 5-minute timeout, third = one hour. Requires Moderate Members and the bot's role above the member's role.
protection.customWords: Custom blocked words (one per line or comma-separated)
protection.customWords.hint: Any message containing one of these words is deleted immediately with a temporary notice to the author.
protection.blockedDomains: Blocked link domains (one per line or comma-separated)
protection.blockedDomains.hint: Any message containing a link to one of these domains is deleted automatically (e.g. tiktok.com).
protection.antiSpam.hint: Posting the same message (5+ characters) into 3 or more channels within a minute deletes every copy and DMs the sender a notice. Admins are exempt — test with a regular member account; the bot needs the Manage Messages permission.
protection.logChannelId.hint: Deletions are logged here including the removed content — leave empty to disable logging.
welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.enabled.hint: Automatically sends a welcome message whenever a new member joins the server.
welcome.channelId.hint: The channel where welcome messages are posted.
welcome.autoRole.hint: Granted automatically to every new member on join — works even when welcome messages are disabled. Requires Manage Roles and the bot's role above this role.
welcome.message.hint: Use {user}, {server} and {count} as placeholders for the member, server name and member count
welcome.showName: Show member name on the banner
welcome.showName.hint: Draws the new member's name under their avatar on the welcome image.
welcome.farewell.hint: A text message in the same welcome channel when a member leaves the server.
welcome.farewellMessage.hint: Use {user} for the departing member's name, plus {server} and {count} as usual.
welcome.upload: Upload a banner image — click or drop a file here
welcome.uploadFailed: Upload failed — use a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image up to 8 MB
welcome.preview: Preview — drag the circle to position the avatar; resize with the mouse wheel or the corner grip
botProfile.title: Bot profile (this server)
botProfile.name: Bot name in this server
botProfile.name.hint: Leave empty to use the bot's default name
botProfile.avatar.hint: Applied to this server if Discord allows it, otherwise to the bot's global profile on all servers.
botProfile.globalNote: Discord applied the image to the bot's global profile (all servers)
botProfile.noPermission: The bot lacks the Change Nickname permission in this server
botProfile.uploadFailed: Upload failed — use a PNG, JPEG or GIF image up to 8 MB
summary.title: Weekly summary
summary.enabled.hint: Every Friday evening the bot posts the week's activity: message count, voice minutes and the top three most active members.
summary.channelId.hint: The channel where the weekly summary is posted.

commands.start.title: Create an automation in one click
commands.start.hint: Pick a template and tweak it — the trigger phrase, who may use it, and what happens. Voice system commands and Discord (/) commands are configured from the sidebar list.
commands.template.ai.prompt: Answer briefly and in a friendly tone.
commands.template.scheduled.name: Scheduled message
commands.issue.noTrigger: Add at least one trigger phrase or enable the schedule in the trigger node
commands.issue.scheduleChannel: Pick the output channel in the schedule section of the trigger node
commands.issue.memberTarget: Pick the member — or members/roles — this action targets
commands.issue.emptyText: Write the message text in the action
commands.issue.actionChannel: Pick the channel in the action
commands.issue.role: Pick the role in the action
commands.trigger.title: Trigger
commands.schedule.title: Scheduled run
commands.schedule.hint: Runs automatically at the interval you set; the result is posted to the chosen channel.
commands.trigger.builtinPhrases: The built-in phrases stay active in the bot language
commands.builtin.hint: System command — restrict it, add phrases or disable it
commands.condition.title: Who & where
commands.action.repeatHint: Runs at the schedule interval of the automation. Enable to give this step its own timing, e.g. this message every 5 minutes.
commands.slash.hint: Empty lists = everyone. Server admins can always use every command.
commands.slash.desc.join: Bot joins your voice channel and starts listening
commands.slash.desc.speak: Bot reads your text aloud in voice (TTS)
commands.slash.desc.ask: Ask the AI — answers by voice too when connected
commands.slash.desc.summarize: AI summary of recent channel messages
commands.action.target.speaker: The speaker/writer
commands.action.dm.roles: And everyone with one of these roles
commands.action.textHint: {user} = name, {args} = rest of the phrase, {mention} = mentions the named member
commands.action.joinHint: No channel picked = the invoker's current voice channel. Pick a channel for scheduled runs.
commands.action.voiceChatHint: Posts into the text chat of the voice channel the bot is in.
commands.action.dmInactiveHint: DMs every member with no messages or voice activity in this period — max 50 per run, sent slowly. {member} = recipient's name.
commands.trigger.sub: When does it run? Add phrases members say or type, or enable the schedule.
commands.textIntentHint: Text triggers require ENABLE_TEXT_COMMANDS on the server deployment
chatlog.title: Chat log
chatlog.hint: The latest channel messages of the last 7 days — auto-deleted afterwards
chatlog.disabled.title: Message recording is not enabled on the bot
chatlog.disabled.body: Enable the Message Content Intent on the Bot page of the Discord developer portal, then restart the bot — recording is on by default; just make sure ENABLE_CHAT_LOG is not set to false on the bot service. Recording starts from that moment.
